Senior Product Designer - Mercari / Crossborder

About Mercari

Circulate all forms of value to unleash the potential in all people

"What can I do to help society thrive with the finite resources we have?" The Mercari marketplace app was born in 2013 out of this thought by our founder Shintaro Yamada as he traveled the world. We believe that by circulating all forms of value, not just physical things and money, we can create opportunities for anyone to realize their dreams and contribute to society and the people around them. Mercari aims to use technology to connect people all over the world and create a world where anyone can unleash their potential. For more information about Mercari Group’s mission, see Mercari’s Culture Doc


　
Organization/Team Mission

Mercari has been operating marketplaces localized in two countries, Japan and the United States, and the Crossborder team recently released a new global app , already in use in Hong-kong and Taiwan that we aim to deploy  in over 100 countries. For requests from each region, it must be developed with a global perspective, including standardization and consolidation to avoid excessive localization.

The integration of Crossborder e-commerce and local business is heavily reliant on a robust logistics network and efficient operations. This necessitates working closely with numerous third-party vendors. Through this experience, you will acquire a wide range of business knowledge and apply it to engineering, collaborating closely with teams such as product and operations.

Trade-offs will have to be made to build a strong foundation while assuring a reasonable time to market. The team must balance short-term initiatives and the long term goal for the Global Product. Constructive discussions that transcend individual job roles, whether you are an engineer or a Business Developer, are essential for moving forward effectively.

The New Business Design Team leads end-to-end user experience design for emerging product initiatives at Mercari, shaping intuitive, trustworthy, and high-quality experiences for domestic and international users. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Business Development to explore new problem spaces and raise the bar for craft, consistency, and innovation.

See here for more information about our mission and values.


　
Why this role matters 

This role plays a critical part in shaping how buyers experience Mercari at scale. As the marketplace evolves, we’re entering new problem spaces where clarity, trust, and experience quality matter more than ever. Senior Designers in this role don’t just execute solutions — they help define the problems worth solving and set the bar for what “good” looks like.

You’ll be trusted to operate with a high degree of ownership, leading end-to-end experiences in ambiguous areas while balancing user needs, business goals, and long-term product quality. Your work will directly influence how buyers discover value, make confident decisions, and build trust with the marketplace.

This role matters because strong design leadership here creates leverage: it unlocks better collaboration, sharper product thinking, and more durable experiences that scale beyond a single feature or release. We’re looking for designers who care deeply about craft, can think beyond the immediate task, and want to shape the future of the buyer experience internationally.



Work Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design for buyer-facing experiences, from discovery and problem framing through execution and launch.
  • Act as Lead Designer for assigned product areas, setting experience direction and design quality standards.
  • Translate ambiguous business and user problems into clear experience strategies, flows, and high-quality UI.
  • Drive design decisions through strong craft, systems thinking, and user-centered rationale.
  • Collaborate deeply with PM, Eng, and UXR to shape product direction and influence roadmaps.
  • Identify gaps and opportunities beyond the immediate scope and proactively propose new ideas, concepts, or improvements.
  • Contribute to and evolve shared design systems, patterns, and best practices.
  • Provide thoughtful feedback and mentorship to other designers, raising the overall quality of work.


　
Unique Challenges

  • Designing for large-scale, real-world marketplace complexity with diverse buyer needs and behaviors.
  • Leading design in unexplored or undisclosed product areas with high ambiguity and few precedents.
  • Balancing speed, experimentation, and innovation with a high bar for craft, trust, and usability.
  • Navigating cross-team and cross-function alignment while maintaining clear experience ownership.
  • Designing for the Japanese market with strong attention to cultural nuance, trust, and clarity.



Qualifications

  • Required Experience/Skills
    • 6+ years of experience in product, UX, or interaction design with ownership of end-to-end experiences.
    • Strong craft skills across UX, interaction design, and visual design, with a sharp eye for detail and quality.
    • Proven ability to lead design for complex or ambiguous problem spaces.
    • Experience influencing product direction through design thinking, concepts, and storytelling.
    • Solid understanding of design systems, scalable patterns, and consistency at scale.
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills with cross-functional partners.
    • A portfolio demonstrating high-quality shipped work, problem-solving depth, and design leadership.

  • Preferred Experience/Skills
    • Experience designing marketplace, e-commerce, or transaction-based products.
    • Experience acting as a lead designer across multiple teams or initiatives.
    • Familiarity with user research methods and applying insights to design decisions.
    • Experience working in or designing for the Japanese market.
    • Comfort experimenting, prototyping, and iterating quickly in uncertain environments.
    • Conversational Japanese proficiency

  • Language 
    • English: Proficient (CEFR – C1)
    • Japanese: Basic (CEFR – A2)

For details about CEFR, see here.
　

　
Learn More About Mercari Group

Recruiting at Mercari

At Mercari Group, we value empathizing with and embodying the mission and values ​​of the Group and each company. To promote the creation of an organization that maximizes the total amount of value exhibited by all members, we would like to understand the experience and skills of each candidate as accurately as possible.

  • Interview: The number of interviews may vary depending on the position.
  • Reference check: We will ask for online references around the timing of the final interview.

Equal Opportunity Hiring

Here at Mercari, we work to realize a world in which no one’s potential is limited by their background and everyone has the opportunity to freely create value. We also firmly believe that a mindset of Inclusion & Diversity is essential for us to achieve our mission.

This, of course, extends to our hiring practices as well. Mercari is committed to eliminating discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, physical disability, and other such factors so that anyone who shares our mission and values can join us, regardless of their background. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Product Owner who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and turns customer, market and stakeholder signal into clear priorities. In this role, you will sit inside a product engineering team, alongside the lead and product engineers, shaping problem statements, backlog and sprint plans that the whole team believes in.

This is a full-time role based in Sofia, Bulgaria. We value in person collaboration and meet in the office at least 3 times a week.

Some of the things you'll work on:

Bring outside context into the team, including customer feedback, support trends, usage data and competitive landscape.

  • Write clear, honest problem statements that a product engineer can pick up and run with.
  • Track outcomes after a feature ships, not just whether it ships.
  • Keep the backlog tidy and up to date in Jira, drafting new items and retiring stale ones.
  • Draft problem statements and acceptance criteria for new tickets, finishing acceptance criteria jointly with a product engineer where needed.
  • Run backlog grooming as a working session with product engineers.
  • Bring a clear "why it matters" into sprint planning and set the sprint goal together with the lead and product engineers.
  • Surface new signal that could shift priorities and work through trade-offs before committing to changes mid-sprint.
  • Shape and sequence the roadmap together with the lead and engineers, and own the "what problem is worth solving" call.
  • Join sprint reviews and demos to check delivered work against the original problem.

We're excited if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or similar role, with real day-to-day ownership of a backlog.
  • Hands-on experience running Jira, including writing tickets and running or co-running grooming sessions.
  • Comfort working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers rather than handing off finished specs.
  • Strong plain-language writing skills for problem statements and acceptance criteria.
  • Enough technical fluency to follow a trade-off conversation and ask the right questions.
  • A track record of prioritising under pressure, including saying no and explaining why.
  • Genuine curiosity about the "why" behind customer and business problems.
  • Familiarity with tools like Notion, Mixpanel or Amplitude for tracking outcomes post-launch.
  • Some direct customer-facing experience, such as support, sales engineering, customer success or research.

Why you'll love it here:

  • Flexible working hours and home-office (2x per week)
  • Internal shares programme (EDPP)
  • Ergonomic workspace and cutting-edge technology
  • Regular team events
  • Modern and stylish offices
  • Sustainable merch for all employees
  • Adverity Social Responsibility Days (+2 days paid off)

Are you ready to apply?

Apply now if you are ready to revolutionise the way businesses work with marketing data.

We look forward to meeting you!

Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.

Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.

As a Senior Product Designer at PF, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the design and user experience of our B2B products. You will drive the design process from discovery to delivery, taking ownership of projects and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions. As a senior member of the design team, you will work alongside other designers, contribute to design strategy, and ensure that our products align with both customer needs and business goals. This role offers you the chance to lead complex design projects, work on strategic initiatives, and be a key player in achieving PF’s mission to become the most trusted partner in real estate across the MENA region.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design Leadership: Lead the end-to-end design process for one or more B2C products—from discovery and ideation through prototyping, user testing, and delivery. Set a high bar for craft, quality, and execution across the team.

  • User-Centred Design: Champion user needs throughout the product development lifecycle, creating intuitive, effective experiences that balance customer value with business goals.

  • UI & Visual Design: Demonstrate exceptional UI and visual design skills, with a strong eye for detail, interaction design, motion, micro-interactions, and creating moments of delight.

  • Rapid Execution: Produce high-quality design work in fast-paced environments while maintaining strong design thinking, process, and attention to detail.

  • Problem Solving: Translate user research, data, and business objectives into thoughtful product solutions. Continuously iterate to improve usability, engagement, and outcomes.

  • Collaboration: Partner closely with product managers, researchers, engineers, and fellow designers to define problems, align on solutions, and deliver exceptional product experiences.

  • Design Strategy: Help shape the design strategy for the B2B product suite, ensuring a consistent experience across web and mobile. Collaborate with other design teams to evolve a unified product vision and design language.

  • Testing & Iteration: Validate concepts through prototyping, user testing, and experimentation, using feedback and data to refine designs and improve product outcomes.

Desired Experience:

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in Product Design, UX, or a related discipline, with a proven track record of shipping high-quality digital products in fast-paced environments.

  • Design Craft: Expertise across product discovery, UX, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and design systems. Strong ability to use research and data to inform decisions.

  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect user needs with business objectives and contribute to product and design strategy.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams and presenting design rationale with confidence.

  • Mentorship: Passion for supporting and developing other designers through coaching, feedback, and leading by example.

  • Ownership & Execution: Self-driven and accountable, with the ability to lead complex initiatives from concept through launch while maintaining a high standard of quality.

  • Attention to Detail: A strong eye for visual polish, usability, accessibility, and the small details that create exceptional user experiences.

  • AI Proficiency: Fluency with AI tools across the design process, from research synthesis to rapid prototyping. Critical evaluation of AI output and knowledge when generative capabilities genuinely improve an experience versus when they don't.

  • Content Creation (Nice to Have): Experience creating product videos, motion graphics, or other visual content is a plus.

Our promise to talent

At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.

  1. Think Future First

  2. Data Beats Opinions, Speed Beats Perfection

  4. Act Like An Owner

  5. The Biggest Risk is Taking no Risk at All

Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Product Designer to join our Education team in Berlin. In this individual contributor role, you will help shape learning experiences that support medical students and professionals as they prepare for career-defining exams and continue learning throughout their careers.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals  globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this role be exciting for you?

You will shape the end-to-end exam preparation experience, with a focus on our Qbank product. Your work will help medical learners globally, to  practice more effectively, close knowledge gaps, simulate real exam conditions, and benefit from personalized, AI-powered learning experiences, directly supporting AMBOSS's mission to empower healthcare professionals.

Working in a cross-functional team with Product, Engineering, Medical, User Research, and Design, you'll turn user needs into intuitive, practical solutions, validate them with users and data, and bring them to life.

This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys simplifying complex workflows, is passionate about educational and medical UX, and is excited to explore how AI can enhance both learning and the design process. You will report to the Director of UX Design.


You will:

 - Design and improve the end-to-end exam preparation experience for medical students and professionals in Germany, the United States, and international and adjacent healthcare markets across desktop and mobile.

 - Work as part of the Qbank Experience Team, collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Medical, Research, and Design to understand user needs and turn them into thoughtful product experiences.

 - Take ownership of assigned design problems and projects, from understanding the problem and exploring concepts through prototyping, validation, detailed design, and implementation.

 - Design and prototype learning experiences that help users practice effectively, reinforce knowledge, and prepare confidently for professional exams.

 - Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform your design decisions, working with our in-house User Research and Data teams to understand user behavior, validate solutions, and iterate on your designs.

 - Collaborate with medical experts and editors to understand the needs of our highly knowledgeable users and translate complex medical and educational requirements into simple, intuitive experiences.

 - Work closely with engineers throughout the design and implementation process to ensure that shipped experiences reflect the design intent while taking technical opportunities and constraints into account.

 - Collaborate with other product teams to help create a cohesive and personalized user experience across relevant parts of AMBOSS, such as sign-up, dashboard, shop, and user profile.

 - Apply and advocate for strong design principles, usability, and accessibility, contributing to high-quality and consistent experiences across AMBOSS.

 - Contribute to the wider AMBOSS Design community through design critiques, knowledge sharing, and contributions to our design system, interaction patterns, and other shared design topics.

 - Build a deep understanding of our users and advocate for their needs throughout the product development process.



You bring:

 - 3+ years of professional experience in UX or product design, with strong skills in information architecture and communicating complex information clearly and concisely.

 - Strong user-centered design skills, attention to detail, and a solid understanding of UX and visual design fundamentals.

 - Proficiency in Figma and modern prototyping tools, with an interest in using AI tools to support and improve the design process.

 - Ability to work through design challenges and translate complexity into simple, intuitive, scalable and user-friendly experiences.

 - A passion for creating great user experiences and for validating and iterating on designs to ensure they address user needs.

 - Ability to translate product goals and user needs into thoughtful design solutions, from early concepts through to implementation details.

 - A collaborative and iterative approach to design, with openness to feedback and working closely with others.

 - A growth mindset and interest in developing a deep understanding of educational UX for a product designed for medical experts rather than a general audience.

 - Experience using research insights and data to inform design decisions and participating in user research studies.

 - Experience working effectively in cross-functional teams, including product, design, engineering, and research, and collaborating with a range of stakeholders.

You enjoy:



 - Digging into complex UX problems and experimenting to find simple, effective solutions for users.

 - Working collaboratively with Product, Engineering, Medical, Research, plus commercial teams, rather than designing in isolation.

 - Using research, data, and feedback to challenge assumptions and improve your designs.

 - Moving from early concepts to detailed interaction and UI design.

 - Learning about complex domains and developing empathy for highly knowledgeable, specialist users.

 - Design systems and contributing to it

 - Giving and receiving constructive design feedback and learning from other designers.

 - Exploring new tools and ways of working, including AI, and thoughtfully applying them to your design process.



Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

Location: Europe remote or London hybrid

We're looking for a Staff (L6) Product Designer to own that layer end-to-end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.

   - License and billing models that admins can actually understand and manage at scale.

 - Set a design vision for our Enterprise surface and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent. As things scale across SSO, compliance, analytics, and billing, you're keeping the mental model consistent.
   
   


YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU BRING:

 - Significant experience designing complex, large-scale product surfaces - ideally admin dashboards, governance layers, analytics platforms, or other domains where system thinking matters.

You’ll own defined product features from discovery through to delivery, combining user insight, interaction design and strong visual design. You’ll work within a supportive, experienced design environment, partnering closely with Product, Engineering and Operations.

 - Conduct research, observation and usability testing with operators, guests and customers

 - Turn user needs, complex technology and operational requirements into clear journeys, workflows and interactions

 - Apply inclusive and accessible design principles, considering a broad range of needs, abilities and contexts of use

 - Design interactions across visual interfaces, sound, haptics and lighting, considering how they work together as one experience

 - Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes and polished production-ready designs

 - Define interaction states, edge cases and feedback in sufficient detail for implementation

 - Collaborate with stakeholders to balance user needs, product goals and technical constraints

 - Review implementation, resolve design issues and help maintain a high quality bar in the finished experience

 - Contribute reusable interaction and visual patterns across Wayve’s vehicle-related products

 


ABOUT YOU  

For this role, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.


ESSENTIAL

 - A portfolio demonstrating strong interaction and visual/UI craft, including the ability to make complex information and interactions clear without losing important detail

 - An understanding of inclusive and accessible design, and how different needs and contexts can shape an experience

 - Strong wireframing and prototyping skills, with the ability to choose the right level of fidelity for the problem

 - Curiosity and sound judgement: you’re comfortable questioning assumptions, exploring different approaches and working through ambiguity and constraints

 - Clear communication and the ability to explain the thinking behind your design decisions

 - Experience owning product problems through discovery, design, validation and delivery

 - Experience planning and conducting user research or usability testing and applying what you learn

 - Experience collaborating closely with product managers and engineers throughout product development


DESIRABLE

You'll take ownership of our most complex design challenges, working across the full product lifecycle from discovery to delivery.  - Proven Leadership: A deep track record as a Senior or Lead Product Designer, successfully shipping impactful digital products across web and mobile ecosystems.

 - A Builder’s Instinct: You don’t stop at the design file. You love getting your hands dirty and have experience shipping code, building your own products, or spinning up functional, high-fidelity tools and prototypes.

 - Versatile Experience: A strong grasp of consumer journeys, ideally with experience navigating both B2C and B2B product landscapes.

 - An AI-Forward Mindset: A highly considered approach to AI in design. You understand how to strategically use it to accelerate work, when to rely on human judgment, and how to guide a team through this evolving landscape.

BENEFITS

jobs.description: <p>關於團隊<br>FinTech UX 團隊負責打造 Coupang 生態系中的直覺化、值得信賴且具可擴展性的金融服務體驗。我們的使命是透過建立卓越的支付體驗，幫助顧客輕鬆且安心地完成付款，進一步消除電商流程中的各種摩擦與障礙。<br>作為台灣支付（Taiwan Payments）團隊的資深產品設計師（Staff Product Designer），您將負責規劃並推動關鍵支付體驗的設計策略與執行，涵蓋整個顧客旅程。您將與產品管理、工程、資料科學、商務、營運、風險管理、法務合規及行銷團隊密切合作，共同定義台灣支付服務的未來藍圖。<br>這是一個高度策略性的個人貢獻者（Individual Contributor, IC）職位，適合能夠親自參與設計工作、善於面對不確定性、影響產品發展方向，並創造實質商業與客戶價值的設計領導者。<br><br><br>【工作內容】<br><br>• 主導台灣支付產品與體驗的端到端設計流程，從策略制定、設計執行到後續優化。<br>• 定義使用者體驗（UX）願景，影響產品策略，並規劃支付體驗發展藍圖（Roadmap）。<br>• 設計流暢且值得信賴的支付旅程，涵蓋結帳流程（Checkout）、電子錢包（Wallet）、身份驗證（Authentication）及未來金融科技產品。<br>• 領導具高度不確定性的 0→1 創新專案，打造全新的支付體驗，創造客戶與商業價值。<br>• 將使用者洞察、商業目標、技術限制及法規要求轉化為直覺且易用的產品體驗。<br>• 透過使用者研究、數據分析、產品實驗及市場洞察，發掘機會並推動可衡量的商業成果。<br>• 定義成功指標，持續改善轉換率（Conversion）、支付成功率、產品採用率及顧客信任度。<br>• 建立可擴展的設計框架、設計模式（Design Patterns）及支付體驗相關 UX 標準。<br>• 與產品、工程、資料科學、風險管理、法務、合規及商業團隊緊密合作，交付高品質解決方案，並影響組織層級決策。<br>&nbsp;<br><br>【條件要求】<br>&nbsp;<br>• 平面設計、互動設計、工業設計、人機互動（HCI）、資訊工程、心理學或相關科系學位，或具同等工作經驗。<br>• 8年以上產品設計（Product Design）、使用者體驗設計（UX Design）或相關領域工作經驗。<br>• 具備設計並成功推出面向消費者數位產品的實務經驗。<br>• 擁有優秀作品集，能展現策略思維、UX問題解決能力、互動設計、視覺設計能力及可衡量的商業成果。<br>• 曾主導複雜、高度模糊且跨部門合作的專案，從概念發想到正式上線。<br>• 精通以使用者為中心（User-Centered Design）的設計方法與完整產品設計流程。<br>• 熟練使用 Figma 及現代設計工具。<br>• 能透過簡報、敘事能力（Storytelling）及數據清楚表達設計理念與決策依據。<br>• 具備與產品管理及工程團隊密切合作的經驗。<br>• 具備優秀的跨部門協作與利害關係人管理能力。<br>• 具備流利中文及英文溝通能力。<br><br>&nbsp;<br>【加分條件】<br><br>• 具備支付（Payments）、金融科技（FinTech）、銀行、電子錢包、貸款、信用卡或金融服務產品設計經驗。<br>• 曾參與台灣或其他亞太地區（APAC）市場產品設計工作。<br>• 深入了解支付生態系統、風險控管、身份驗證、防詐騙機制及相關法規要求。<br>• 具備運用使用者研究與數據分析推動產品策略制定的經驗。<br>• 曾在高速成長且大規模運作的組織環境中工作。<br>• 具備電子商務（E-commerce）、平台市集（Marketplace）或大型消費者產品平台相關經驗。<br>• 曾成功影響高階主管決策並推動組織共識建立。<br>• 能夠整合質化與量化研究成果，轉化為具體可執行的產品與設計決策。</p>

jobs.title: iGaming UI/UX Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://ondeckglobal.com/

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with a strong understanding of the iGaming industry to create engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences.
You will be responsible for designing user-focused interfaces across online casino, sportsbook, betting, and gaming platforms, working closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to transform product requirements into seamless player experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with UX thinking and understands how to design interfaces that are engaging, responsive, conversion-focused, and easy to navigate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design modern, high-quality UI/UX for iGaming websites, web apps, and mobile experiences.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.
  • Design key iGaming experiences such as casino lobbies, sportsbook interfaces, game discovery, promotions, tournaments, loyalty/VIP areas, registration, deposits, and withdrawals.
  • Improve player journeys with a focus on usability, engagement, retention, and conversion.
  • Build and maintain scalable design systems, UI components, typography, iconography, and reusable design patterns.
  • Create responsive designs that deliver a consistent experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Development, Marketing, CRM, and other teams from concept through implementation.
  • Work with developers to ensure accurate implementation and maintain high visual quality.
  • Use research, analytics, user feedback, and product insights to identify UX improvements.
  • Continuously improve existing interfaces through iteration, testing, and optimization.
  • Stay current with iGaming design trends, competitor products, UX best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Design with accessibility, responsible gaming principles, and market-specific requirements in mind.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience, preferably within iGaming, gaming, fintech, entertainment, or another fast-paced digital product environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating polished UI design and thoughtful UX problem-solving.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, prototyping, and design systems.
  • Strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.
  • Excellent knowledge of typography, spacing, grids, color, hierarchy, and interaction design.
  • Experience translating complex product requirements into simple, intuitive user experiences.
  • Good understanding of user journeys, conversion funnels, and usability principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and understand technical constraints.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain consistency across large products.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

iGaming Experience — Strong Advantage

Experience designing any of the following will be highly valued:

  • Online Casino & Live Casino
  • Sportsbook & Sports Betting
  • Slots and Game Lobbies
  • Registration & KYC flows
  • Deposits, Withdrawals & Payment UX
  • Bonuses & Promotions
  • VIP & Loyalty Programs
  • Tournaments & Gamification
  • Player Account & Wallet Experiences
  • CRM and Retention Experiences
  • Multi-brand or White-label Gaming Platforms

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization.
  • Understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end development principles.
  • Experience working with analytics and behavioral tools.
  • Experience designing gamification and reward mechanics.
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.
  • Experience working with international or multi-market products.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsible gaming UX.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for more than someone who can make screens look good.
You should be able to understand player behavior, business objectives, and product requirements, then turn them into experiences that are intuitive, engaging, and commercially effective.
You care about the details, challenge weak UX, communicate your design decisions clearly, and enjoy building digital products that players genuinely enjoy using.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ondeckglobal-igaming-ui-ux-designer

Joining INGENIOUS.BUILD means embarking on an incredible journey to create the first cloud application for managing the entire lifecycle of a real estate construction project. You'll be building what some consider the holy grail of construction project management. It's a big, bold, and audacious endeavor, and if you have what it takes, you'll play a direct role in its development. 


And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll be directly involved in its development. The rest, as they say, will be history...



About the role:


 


We are actively seeking a skilled Senior Product Designer to join our dynamic team. As a Product Designer at INGENIOUS.BUILD, you’ll play a key role in crafting and enhancing user interfaces for our platform in close collaboration with product management and engineering teams. You’ll have the opportunity to build prototypes, gather feedback from stakeholders, and ensure the seamless integration of design elements across our platform. Skills and Experience needed:

  • Proficiency in Figma

  • Ability to create and maintain Design System

  • Demonstrated self-motivation, a proactive mindset, and an ownership mentality to drive projects independently and deliver high-quality results


Benefits of Working with Us:



  • We provide high-performance company laptops for optimal productivity

We're fired up to learn more about you to see how you can help us on our mission! 


We genuinely look forward to receiving your application after submitting your information a member from the Recruitment Team will reach out accordingly.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

About the role


At Thatch, design is one of the defining traits that sets us apart. The healthcare experience in America has long been subpar, and the bar for quality design is low — we’re raising that bar, and with it, the entire health insurance industry.


As a designer at Thatch, you’ll craft beautiful experiences for the people using our product every day: businesses, their teams, and brokers. You’ll shape all aspects of design, including UI components for our design system, new products involving complex user interactions, and the overall strategy and vision of the design team. Your work will help create a better insurance experience that enables members to get the healthcare benefits they need while feeling calm, fulfilled, and liberated.


We’re looking for someone who can meet users where they are in their journey and inspire trust by delivering simple, beautiful, and well-crafted end-to-end experiences. You should be comfortable owning the entire design process, from UX strategy to product design and company branding.



What you'll do



  • Participate in and shape every part of the product development process, from idea inception to production

  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, product, sales, operations, and leadership to create incredible user experiences

  • Develop and maintain the design system and brand assets we’ll use across the company

  • Write design documentation and guidelines for internal audiences

  • Iterate on and improve our design standards, tooling, and processes




Background we're looking for



  • 4+ years of experience in product design roles

  • Obsession with understanding and serving users and, ultimately, making their lives better

  • Demonstrated first principle thinking and mastery of fundamental design principles

  • Experience operating in ambiguous environments solving complex user problems

  • Ability to balance blue sky creativity and dedication to craft with bias to action




Experience we’d be particularly excited about



  • Ability to read and/or write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

  • Background scaling high growth technology companies in the past

  • Experience or interest in finance, healthcare, or benefits




What to expect


We want this process to be transparent, thoughtful, and reflective of the work you’ll be doing every day. Our goal is to learn how you think, collaborate, and create — while giving you a clear sense of the team, our culture, and how we work together. Here’s what the process looks like:



  • 30-minute video interview screen to talk through your background and interest in Thatch.

  • 30 minute first-round video interview with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience, approach to design, and how you work.

  • 30 minute video meetings to connect with two members of the team

  • 60-minute video meeting portfolio review with members of the design team to walk through your projects, your process, and the impact of your work.

  • 30 minute video meeting with our founder to discuss culture, values, and how we operate as a company.



We aim to move efficiently while giving you space to share your thinking, ask questions, and get a real sense of what it’s like to work here.



 



About Thatch


We’re a fully distributed early stage company using technology to change the way America does healthcare. We’re a happy, friendly, high-velocity team. You can read more on Thatch here.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer (Clinical Education Platform)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Toronto, ON / Austin, TX / Canada Remote / USA Remote

About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

Fullscript Academy is an education platform designed to support healthcare providers in delivering effective whole person care through evidence-based ingredient education and advanced diagnostic training. We deliver education through a variety of formats, including courses, webinars, articles, clinical guides, and in-app resources to support real-time clinical decision-making.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the future of clinical education on Fullscript Academy. You are a strong product designer first and foremost, with deep experience in user experience design and a sharp eye for creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that reduce complexity. You design with a high standard of craft, creating experiences that feel credible, modern, and appropriate for a clinical, professional audience.

You have experience designing products that support learning, not just usage. You understand how to design for comprehension, retention, motivation, and long-term behavior change, and you know the difference between helping a user complete a task and helping them truly understand something.

What You’ll Do:

    • Support seamless provider journeys across onboarding, content discovery, and course enrollment.
    • Design experiences that help providers understand and retain clinical knowledge, stay motivated over time, and apply learning with confidence.
    • Go beyond a single surface by creating the connective tissue between Academy and the broader Fullscript product ecosystem, ensuring context carries across experiences and learning naturally transitions into action.
    • Lead nimble, iterative UX research and testing to validate ideas, experiment with interaction patterns and information architecture, and refine solutions in a fast-moving environment.
    • Translate user insights, behavioral data, and product strategy into clear, thoughtful design direction.
    • Partner closely with Engineering to deliver high-quality, well-documented designs, adapt to technical constraints, and collaboratively refine scope and solutions.
    • Collaborate with clinicians and content leaders to shape new educational formats, deeply understand learning objectives, and design experiences that reduce complexity while preserving clinical nuance.
    • Contribute to scalable patterns that maintain clarity, credibility, and consistency across Academy.

What You Bring:

    • Strong product design craft across user experience research, user experience design, and visual design.
    • Experience designing digital products end to end, from discovery and concept development through stakeholder alignment, prototyping, and developer handoff.
    • Experience working closely with engineering teams, adapting to technical constraints, refining scope collaboratively, and delivering clear, production-ready design files.
    • Experience designing for learning, behavior change, or knowledge retention outcomes.
    • Experience working across connected surfaces or product ecosystems.

Bonus if you have experience with:

    • Professional EdTech platforms
    • Digital onboarding or academy-style products
    • Financial education or financial literacy tools
    • Knowledge or learning-enhancement platforms (e.g., AI note-taking tools)
    • Healthcare experience is a plus, but not required.

What we can offer you:

    • Generous PTO and competitive pay 
    • Fullscript’s RRSP/401k match program for financial health 
    • Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program
    • Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives 
    • Discount on Fullscript catalog of products 
Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $115,000 and $145,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only and does not include stock options, wellness stipends, or other benefits that are part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.
